schema.name: preset name (original)
schema.dna: draft DNA, canonical, checked with core/dna.cpp parse() on main d61652f
schema.K_used: root note set by the generator (main layer's estimated root after its steps)
schema.voices_per_note: recorders one note uses (sum of harmony x unison)
schema.needs_library: library-disc sounds already collected in the library lane
schema.needs_new_library: library-disc sounds proposed in AESTHETIC-PRESETS.md section 6
schema.works_on_311: true if every NAME exists on Windows 3.11
schema.status: v2 = plays on main today; v2+library = needs library-disc sounds; (v3 note) = a v3 gene would improve it

presets.name: Atrium Keys
presets.intent: Soft electric-piano chords that sound three shops away.
presets.chain: Trim the bell strike, slow it one octave, echo it; a quieter, brighter copy enters 20 ms late.
presets.voice: Two layers, slight unison wow, left/right split.

presets.name: Food Court Nylon
presets.intent: A bossa-nova nylon pluck for one-finger comping.
presets.chain: COMB idiom: echo twice, then speed up, so the echo becomes a string resonance; slowed after.
presets.voice: Pluck plus a quiet fixed click for the fingernail.

presets.name: Escalator Ascent
presets.intent: A slow string pad that rises and drifts left to right, like riding up past a skylight.
presets.chain: Drop the attack, slow two octaves, echo; drawn envelope and pan envelope.

presets.name: Empty Concourse
presets.intent: Hold one key: distant shoppers under a slowed startup chord. A bed for a whole track.
presets.chain: The ambience is quiet and fixed; the startup bloom is slowed twice and echoed.
presets.voice: Bed layer (fixed pitch) plus a pitched pad.

presets.name: Lobby Vibes
presets.intent: Vibraphone with motor tremolo, the sound of a hotel-lobby jazz trio.
presets.chain: The sine-like Print bell, slowed and echoed. The tremolo is an 8-point drawn amplitude envelope.
presets.voice: H0 only, so 12 voices of polyphony.
presets.v3: A looping amplitude envelope (repeat the last N points) would keep the tremolo going past 1 s.

presets.name: Paging Chime
presets.intent: The two-tone public-address chime that comes before an announcement.
presets.chain: Notify already alternates a fourth; slowed once and echoed it is a store PA chime.
presets.voice: Unison 2 for a cheap speaker chorus.

presets.name: Department Strings
presets.intent: Lush, polite string pad for the cosmetics floor.
presets.chain: Logon body slowed once; shutdown body slowed twice, quieter, entering later.
presets.voice: Two layers, wide unison, pan apart.

presets.name: Elevator Alto
presets.intent: A smooth-jazz alto sax line, slowed into a dream (needs the GM render).
presets.chain: A GM alto sax note rendered in Windows, slowed one octave and echoed.

presets.name: Closing Announcement
presets.intent: Last call: a falling cadence with pre-echo, then the lights go off.
presets.chain: PRE-VERB idiom (reverse, echo, reverse) after a slow-down, so echo arrives before the note.

presets.name: Fountain Coins
presets.intent: Bright bell plinks with a long, wet echo, as coins hit a fountain.
presets.chain: Ding with LONG-ECHO (slow, echo, speed up); a soft droplet mixed into the attack.
presets.voice: Bell layer plus droplet layer, offset 10 ms.

presets.name: Atrium Marimba
presets.intent: Warm wood mallet for lounge riffs.
presets.chain: The Ding body is a soft marimba; slowed chord adds a quiet low bloom.

presets.name: Startup Loop Half Speed
presets.intent: The last figure of the startup sound looped four times; lower keys screw it slower.
presets.chain: GRAIN (keep a slice), double it twice with @0CP, slow one octave, echo.
presets.voice: Key-tracked on purpose: tape-style speed, so pitch and tempo fall together.

presets.name: Logon Stutter
presets.intent: A one-beat stutter: the same short slice repeated eight times, then the phrase continues.
presets.chain: Copy a short slice, paste it in front of itself three times (8 hits), then Insert the full logon after.

presets.name: Chord Screw Down
presets.intent: A chopped-and-screwed stab: the chord, then the same chord an octave down, then two.
presets.chain: Sound Recorder cannot slow only part of a buffer, so three layers do it: each one is slower and starts later.
presets.voice: Three layers at O0 / O350 / O1050, each one octave lower; a tape-stop feel.

presets.name: Reverse Ding Loop
presets.intent: A backwards bell fragment looped into a hypnotic swell.
presets.chain: Reverse, keep the swell part, loop it 4x, echo.

presets.name: Fanfare Fragment
presets.intent: The middle of the ta-da fanfare as a slowed four-beat loop.
presets.chain: GRAIN on the brass middle, loop 4x, slow, echo twice.

presets.name: Ringback Lullaby
presets.intent: A phone ringback tone looped and slowed into a pulsing drone.
presets.chain: Loop 8x, slow twice; the beating of the two tones becomes a slow tremolo.

presets.name: Gate Echo Startup
presets.intent: The whole startup slowed with echoes between, then cut into a chopped gate by Delete.
presets.chain: BLUR-DOWN (slow, echo, slow, echo) with a delete-after at 60 % to end on the bloom.

presets.name: Hold Music Loop
presets.intent: A public-domain hold-music excerpt cut to one bar and looped (library sound).
presets.chain: GRAIN of about 2 s, loop 4x, echo; tune by ear (no measured root).

presets.name: Notify Ping-Pong
presets.intent: A two-note chime looped, then echoed left and right on the beat.
presets.chain: Loop 2x; three offset layers make a tempo delay (500 ms = 120 BPM quarter).
presets.voice: Taps at 0/500/1000 ms, panned L/R/L, falling level.
presets.v3: Tempo-synced offsets (O in beats) would follow the DAW tempo.

presets.name: Shutdown Ascending
presets.intent: The falling shutdown cadence played backwards, looped twice: the screw-up.
presets.chain: Reverse, loop 2x, slow, echo.

presets.name: Midnight Tines
presets.intent: A dusty electric piano for maj7 and min9 voicings at 70 BPM.
presets.chain: DX-style tine (xpding strike) over a looped ringout body; DECIMATE round trip on the body for VHS dullness; crumple dust.
presets.voice: Three layers; dust is fixed pitch and quiet.

presets.name: News Break Strings
presets.intent: Synth strings from a 1980s local news break, slightly out of tune.
presets.chain: Body only, slowed, decimated (><), wide unison.

presets.name: Velvet Fretless
presets.intent: A round fretless-bass slide sound for walking lines (GM render).
presets.chain: GM fretless, unchanged; a quiet slowed rising bloop under it gives the slide.
presets.voice: Bend range 12 so the wheel slides.

presets.name: Tape Sax
presets.intent: A tenor sax note slowed and smeared, as on a worn VHS (GM render).
presets.chain: Slow, decimate, echo.
presets.voice: Wide wow unison; macro 2 (motion) opens the wow from 8 to 40 cents.

presets.name: Rainy Window Keys
presets.intent: Soft keys and rain on the glass, for a sleepy hook.
presets.chain: Default bell trimmed and slowed for a felt piano; rain is a fixed bed.
presets.voice: Keys layer plus fixed rain layer.

presets.name: Weather Map Pad
presets.intent: A warm synth pad for a forecast scroll at 2 a.m.
presets.chain: Startup body slowed with echo; logon slowed twice behind it.

presets.name: Barber Chair Organ
presets.intent: A soft drawbar organ for slowed smooth-jazz loops.
presets.chain: LOOP-OSC on ringout, then octave and fifth by harmony.
presets.voice: H0,12,19 at U1 keeps chords possible.

presets.name: VHS Bell Pad
presets.intent: A bright bell-pad hybrid with tape wow, the brighter VHS-pop color.
presets.chain: Reversed chime sparkle, a wow-heavy logon body.

presets.name: Slow Jam Bass
presets.intent: A soft synth bass for slowed R&B.
presets.chain: The error tone slowed twice and trimmed, a little clip for body.

presets.name: Static Lullaby
presets.intent: Music box through a cheap TV speaker.
presets.chain: Chimes front decimated hard (>>><<<), print bell under it.

presets.name: Channel Surf
presets.intent: Each key jumps to another "channel": a chime ident, a tone, a crumple, a voice.
presets.chain: SPLICE-SEQ: Insert File chains short pieces into one 3-second strip.
presets.voice: Fixed pitch, so every key starts the same strip; velocity sets level.

presets.name: Test Pattern Tone
presets.intent: The color-bars test tone: a steady sine, with a slow fade at the end of the night.
presets.chain: LOOP-OSC on the steadiest slice; no unison, no echo.

presets.name: Station Ident
presets.intent: A three-note TV station logo: chime, fanfare tail, a voice.
presets.chain: Three layers enter at 0/300/900 ms: an ident sequence on one key.
presets.voice: Pitched chime and fanfare; fixed voice.

presets.name: Forecast Voice
presets.intent: A slowed robot forecaster, for spoken hooks (Sam render).
presets.chain: Slowed once and echoed; key-tracked so lower keys are lower and slower.

presets.name: Broken Transmission
presets.intent: Speech and tone torn into pieces: a chopped, reversed, decimated strip.
presets.chain: Delete-after/before cut the voice; reverse half; decimate; mix the battery tone at 50 %.

presets.name: Degauss Swell
presets.intent: The CRT degauss thump as a dark, pitched swell (library sound).
presets.chain: Slowed once, reversed for a swell, echoed.

presets.name: Modem Choir
presets.intent: Dial-up handshake slowed two octaves into an eerie chord.
presets.chain: Slow twice; the 30 s cap skips a step if the excerpt is too long, so trim first.

presets.name: Number Station
presets.intent: A voice reading numbers over a tone, for the eerie end of signalwave (Sam render).
presets.chain: Voice fixed; the ringback tone looped underneath as a carrier.

presets.name: Off-Air Hiss
presets.intent: Tape and TV hiss as a texture layer under everything.
presets.chain: Crumple decimated and looped into hiss; volume down.

presets.name: Satellite Bulletin
presets.intent: A 1960 newsreel voice cut to one phrase and echoed (library sound).
presets.chain: Keep a 2-3 s slice; echo; fixed pitch.

presets.name: Contact Online
presets.intent: The two-note "a contact is online" chime as a melodic instrument (Messenger render).
presets.chain: As it is, slight echo; the source is the meaning.

presets.name: Conference Blip
presets.intent: A bright, short call-client bell, for arpeggios (NetMeeting).
presets.chain: Front only, long-echo.

presets.name: Polyphonic Ringtone
presets.intent: An early-2000s polyphonic ringtone lead: bright, square-ish, cheerful.
presets.chain: LOOP-OSC on a short slice, CLIP twice, one octave up.

presets.name: Fantasy Module Pad
presets.intent: The General MIDI "new age" pad, made glossier with a reversed chime halo.
presets.chain: GM pad as it is; chimes reversed and quiet.

presets.name: Sushi Bar Kalimba
presets.intent: A clean, cheerful GM kalimba with a 16th-note echo.
presets.chain: Long-echo; three taps by offset at 125 ms (120 BPM 16ths).

presets.name: Virtual Lobby Steel Drum
presets.intent: GM steel drum for tropical demo-disc riffs.
presets.chain: COMB (EE>) bakes in a metallic ring; then slow back.

presets.name: Synergy Pad
presets.intent: A sung corporate word under a glossy pad: hold one key for a slogan bed (Sam render).
presets.chain: Voice slowed into a vowel smear; logon pad under it.

presets.name: New Mail Arp
presets.intent: A soft mallet arpeggio from the mail alert, playable (Messenger render).
presets.chain: As it is, plus a quiet octave baked in (OCT-BAKE).

presets.name: Bubble Sign-In
presets.intent: A rising bloop then a two-note alert: the "you are signed in" moment.
presets.chain: Bloop at 0 ms, alert at 180 ms.

presets.name: Demo Disc Brass
presets.intent: A glossy synth-brass stab from a 1990s demo disc (GM render).
presets.chain: GM synth brass plus the ta-da attack for bite.

presets.name: Crystal Taskbar
presets.intent: A clean glass-bell pluck with a long, bright halo.
presets.chain: Print bell with a PRE-VERB halo (reverse, echo, reverse); the crystal bell is quiet under it.

presets.name: Glossy Bloom
presets.intent: A pad that opens like a window fading in: soft attack, bright top, gentle shimmer.
presets.chain: Logon body; reversed bright bells as sparkle.

presets.name: Sparkle Cascade
presets.intent: One key plays a rising four-note glass glissando.
presets.chain: Reversed chimes; harmony gives the chord, offsets give the strum.
presets.v3: A strum gene (each harmony voice O ms later) would do this in one layer.

presets.name: Rounded Corner Chord
presets.intent: A soft major-7th chord pluck, the confident "notification" of 2007.
presets.chain: XP Notify voiced as maj7 (H0,4,7,11).

presets.name: Aurora Glass Pad
presets.intent: A singing glass rim, slowed and wide, for slow keynotes.
presets.chain: Slowed once, echo; tune by ear.

presets.name: Lens Flare Riser
presets.intent: An upward whoosh and a reversed bell meet on the downbeat.
presets.chain: Restore slowed into a long rise; reversed ding ends with the hit.

presets.name: Glass Keyboard
presets.intent: Clean digital EP with a glass edge, for hopeful chord progressions.
presets.chain: Default bell strike over a ringout body.

presets.name: Tray Balloon Bell
presets.intent: A tiny pop plus a soft bell, the sound of a system-tray balloon tip.
presets.chain: Balloon mixed into the xpding attack (MIX-TRANSIENT).

presets.name: Clear Sky Choir
presets.intent: An airy "ooh" pad that sounds clean, not dark (GM render).
presets.chain: GM voice oohs; soft wind under it.

presets.name: Reflection Ping
presets.intent: A glass ping with a ping-pong echo, panned left then right.
presets.chain: Three offset taps.

presets.name: Tank Bubbles
presets.intent: Rounded bloops for bouncy arpeggios.
presets.chain: Balloon with long-echo; a quiet falling bloop for body.

presets.name: Reef Pad
presets.intent: Hold one key: water movement and a calm pad.
presets.chain: Underwater ambience fixed and quiet; logon slowed.

presets.name: Droplet Marimba
presets.intent: A wood mallet with a water drop on every strike.
presets.chain: MIX-TRANSIENT: the plink mixed at the start.

presets.name: Plaza Bossa Keys
presets.intent: Cheerful jazzy keys for a shop channel, in a bright room (GM render).
presets.chain: GM vibes and GM nylon guitar at equal level.

presets.name: Eco Wind Chimes
presets.intent: Wind chimes and birds, the solar-panel brochure sound.
presets.chain: Chime pitched; bird enters later, fixed.

presets.name: Fishbowl Glass
presets.intent: A bright, short glass-bowl tone with a watery echo.
presets.chain: Front kept, long-echo.

presets.name: Lagoon Flute
presets.intent: A breathy pan flute over waves (GM render).
presets.chain: GM pan flute; ocean fixed and quiet.

presets.name: Bubble Sweep
presets.intent: Bubbles slowed into a rising wash.
presets.chain: Bubbles slowed twice; restore whoosh.

presets.name: Hydro Kalimba
presets.intent: Kalimba with a water drop and a bowl ring.
presets.chain: Kalimba as it is; droplet at 5 ms.

presets.name: Aquarium Screensaver
presets.intent: Slow glass bells over a filter hum, for a fish-tank screensaver.
presets.chain: Print slowed, PRE-VERB; ringout slowed twice as a hum.

presets.name: Power-On Ceremony
presets.intent: Hold one key: power hum, a seek clunk, then the startup bloom.
presets.chain: Three layers at 0/600/1400 ms.
presets.voice: Fixed hum and clunk; pitched bloom.

presets.name: Login Wish
presets.intent: The logon phrase as a soft, playable pad with chorus.
presets.chain: As it is, slowed once; chorus.

presets.name: Goodbye Pad
presets.intent: The logoff phrase stretched into a slow, sad string line.
presets.chain: Slow twice, echo.

presets.name: Ninety-Five Bloom
presets.intent: A legacy-style Ab major bloom built from parts, for a short ceremony chord.
presets.chain: Startup body; chimes sparkle; ta-da attack under it.

presets.name: Sixteen-Bit Chimes
presets.intent: The original 8-bit chimes, slowed and echoed; plays on the 3.11 edition too.
presets.chain: Slow once, echo, long-echo.

presets.name: Hyperspace Launch
presets.intent: The pinball launch ramp as a pitched riser and hit (Pinball render).
presets.chain: Launch at 0 ms, bonus chord at 700 ms.

presets.name: Mission Complete Pad
presets.intent: The pinball mission tone slowed into a triumphant pad.
presets.chain: Slow once, echo, chorus.

presets.name: Setup Wizard Swell
presets.intent: The question-mark assistant swell, gentle and welcoming.
presets.chain: As it is with chorus.

presets.name: Shutdown Choir
presets.intent: Shutdown, slowed, reversed then forward: it rises before it falls.
presets.chain: Copy, reverse, then Paste Insert the forward copy at the end.

presets.name: Boot Beep Bass
presets.intent: A short tone stack as a sub bass: the click of a power switch on top.
presets.chain: Battery tone slowed; relay click at the start.

presets.name: Ten Minute Chord
presets.intent: A chord stretched four times and echoed: hold it for a whole track.
presets.chain: BLUR-DOWN twice (slow, echo, slow, echo).

presets.name: Fluorescent Hum
presets.intent: The empty-office buzz: a decimated low tone and office air.
presets.chain: LOOP-OSC on ringout, slowed two octaves, CLIP once; office ambience fixed.

presets.name: Carpet Corridor
presets.intent: A distant, heavily echoed muzak chord from another room.
presets.chain: Slow twice, echo three times, volume down.

presets.name: Neon Rain Pad
presets.intent: Dreampunk: a cold, wide pad with a rain bed, after the film scores.
presets.chain: Shutdown slowed twice, reversed, echo; rain fixed.

presets.name: Memory Of A Memory
presets.intent: Hypnagogic: startup slowed three times, a ghost of itself.
presets.chain: Slow three times (19 s), echo once.

presets.name: Liminal Pool Room
presets.intent: Wet, tiled-room echo on a single water drop, for still scenes.
presets.chain: Slow, echo twice.

presets.name: Sleep Mode
presets.intent: A soft swell that breathes in and out, drawn by an envelope.
presets.chain: Logon slowed; a 5-point breathing envelope; pan envelope.

presets.name: Dial Tone Drone
presets.intent: A phone dial tone slowed into a deep, eerie drone.
presets.chain: Slow twice; echo.

presets.name: Faraway Choir
presets.intent: A choir behind a wall: slowed, muffled, echoed.
presets.chain: Slow once, decimate, echo twice.

presets.name: Ambient Elevator
presets.intent: An elevator ride slowed into a long, falling drone (library sound).
presets.chain: Slow once (if under 15 s), echo.

presets.name: Disco Ball Stab
presets.intent: A filtered-house chord stab for future funk at 118 BPM.
presets.chain: Chord front, CLIP once; ta-da attack. Speed is the filter: macro 1 fades a dull copy into a bright copy.

presets.name: City Pop Bass
presets.intent: A slap-style bass for octave-jumping disco lines (GM render).
presets.chain: As it is, CLIP once for bite.

presets.name: Sidechain Pad
presets.intent: A pad that ducks on every beat, drawn by the envelope (118 BPM eighths).
presets.chain: Logon looped; the envelope gates it eight times.
presets.v3: A loop flag on Ja would repeat the duck for as long as the key is held.

presets.name: Vapor Sub Boom
presets.intent: A long sub for vaporhop / vaportrap beats; wheel bends a fifth.
presets.chain: 808 Sub idiom: ringout body slowed three octaves; a click on top.

presets.name: Lazy Trap Hat
presets.intent: A tiny closed hat for skittering hi-hats.
presets.chain: Menu click and popup burst, fixed.

presets.name: Gabber Brick
presets.intent: A distorted hardvapour kick: clipped, short, tuned low.
presets.chain: Front only, slowed twice, CLIP four times.

presets.name: Hoover Alarm
presets.intent: A harsh, detuned alarm lead for hardvapour drops.
presets.chain: LOOP-OSC on the warning tone, clip, wide unison.

presets.name: Funk Guitar Chop
presets.intent: A muted jazz-guitar chop for disco upstrokes (GM render).
presets.chain: Keep the first 25 %; an octave-up copy 30 ms later makes an upstroke.

presets.name: Anime Sparkle Hit
presets.intent: A bright crash-and-chime hit for the start of a future-funk loop.
presets.chain: Ta-da attack, chimes high, a GM crash fixed.

presets.name: Screwed Kit
presets.intent: A drum kit made of Windows clicks, slowed down: kick, snare, hat in one key-range.
presets.chain: Kick, snare and hat layers; key-tracked so each key is another tuning.
